versions.label: GS 0.971 (this build)
changes: Added a Controls tab for the desktop and phone camera: Orbit (the default), Free-roam (WASD to move, mouse to look, Q/E up and down, Shift to go faster) and Off.
Orbit now circles the scene origin from the first load.
Turned off panning in Orbit mode.

versions.label: GS 0.970
changes: Added a dock at the bottom of the screen that holds the Enter VR button and the version button, so they no longer overlap.

versions.label: GS 0.969
changes: Added Claude Opus 5.5, Claude Sonnet 5.5, Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT6 Sol and GPT6 Luna to the model dropdown.

versions.label: GS 0.968
changes: Fixed the Community Scenes layout on desktop.

versions.label: GS 0.967
changes: Added the GS version button and version picker.
First numbered build. It includes all earlier work, most recently:
Code editor syntax highlighting, a 360 / HDRI environment option and a desktop WASD fix.
GPT6.1 Sol in the model dropdown.
Loading a community scene clears the world first, with a Layer option and no duplicate loads.
The chat window fits on phones, keeps its header inside the visible Safari viewport, and defaults to a see-through panel with a solid border.

note: Newest first. Each entry: { id, label, url, date, changes[] }. url null = this deployment; otherwise a full https URL (Vercel preview, pinned Worker, etc.). changes are shown as the changelog in the version picker.
